text:
Miguel Torres: Hi team, quick onboarding issues: I enrolled in medical and dental during orientation but haven't received an insurance ID card PDF yet. Also my first paycheck shows 0.00 for commuter deduction even though I opted in. Who should I bug?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Miguel! Congrats and glad to have you. For the insurance card PDF we generally send that from the carrier after enrollment completes. Sanya in Benefits can check the carrier queue. For commuter, payroll/Liam can verify if the pre-tax election synced.

Sanya (Benefits): Looking now. I can see your enrollment as Completed on 2024-06-10. Carrier shows "ID card pending" until they process active enrollments (often 3-5 business days). I can request a temporary ID letter PDF from them today.

Miguel Torres: That would be great, thanks. I need it for my dentist tomorrow.

Sanya (Benefits): Got it. I requested an "ID verification letter" and attached it to your BambooHR documents. You should get an email notification; I can also post the PDF here if you prefer.

HR Bot: Document uploaded to BambooHR for Miguel Torres: "ID_letter_06112024.pdf".

Miguel Torres: I see it, thank you! Quick follow-up on commuter: I selected pre-tax transit in the benefits portal and chose monthly $120. I expected the deduction on the 06/15 pay run but it shows $0.00.

Liam (Payroll): Hey Miguel, thanks for flagging. Sometimes the transit election hits payroll after the first cycle depending on calendar cutoff. Can you confirm the effective date you selected? Also did you enter the vendor (transit vendor) or select "Commuter" only?

Miguel Torres: Effective date was 2024-06-10 and I picked "Commuter" with the provider set to "TransitBenefits".

Liam (Payroll): Looks like the election submitted after the payroll cutoff for the 06/15 run. That explains $0.00. You'll see the deduction on 06/30. If you need an advance or reimbursement for June transit, we can issue a one-time taxable reimbursement — ping me and I'll run it.

Miguel Torres: Not necessary, thanks for clarifying. One last question: I noticed the holiday schedule in the handbook lists Juneteenth as floating this year. Does that affect new hires who start mid-month (I started 06/11)? Do I get the prorated holiday day?

Ava (People Ops): Good Q. Company holidays are not prorated for partial-month starts — if a holiday falls while you are an active employee on that calendar day, you get the holiday. Since you started 06/11 and Juneteenth is on 06/19, you'll receive the holiday. PTO accrual is standard (prorated monthly if your role is hourly, exempt employees get monthly accrual).

Miguel Torres: Perfect, thanks so much for the quick help everyone.

Sanya (Benefits): Closing notes: Insurance ID letter uploaded, carrier processing active enrollment (expect official card in ~3-5 business days).

Liam (Payroll): Commuter deduction will appear on 06/30 payroll. If it still doesn't appear by 07/05, DM me and I'll investigate.

Miguel Torres: Appreciated :raised_hands:
